relations.subject: Robert Grosvenor Gardner
relations.object: Film Study Center at Harvard University
relations.evidence: Robert Grosvenor Gardner (November 5, 1925 – June 21, 2014) was an American academic, anthropologist, and documentary filmmaker who was director of the Film Study Center at Harvard University from 1956 to 1997.

relations.subject: Robert Grosvenor Gardner
relations.evidence: He then earned an MA in anthropology from Harvard.
